title: Client list is alphabetical for a large account that expected recent-first
description:
Add the client list to the Clients tab.

AC:
- Given I open Clients, when the list loads, then clients are sorted alphabetically by name.
- Given I have no clients, then I see the empty list.

comments.body: Spoke to support this morning. Accounts with more than 50 clients want most-recently-invoiced first by default, alphabetical stays for small accounts. Adding here so it is on the ticket.
PR up. Alphabetical sort per AC.
Large test account sorts A to Z, expected recent-first for accounts over fifty. Reopening.
Sorted alphabetically instead of recent-first for large accounts. Fixed.

title: Archived clients cannot be found anywhere
description:
Allow archiving a client.

AC:
- Given a client, when I choose Archive, then the client is hidden from the list.

comments.body: Two customers have asked about this one through support, so it is worth doing this sprint rather than next.
PR up. Archive removes the client row from the list query.
Passes AC.
Customer asks where archived clients went. Hidden meant hidden from the default view and reachable through a filter, that is what archive means everywhere else in the product.
Hidden was removing clients from every view instead of only the default one. Adding an Archived filter.

title: Invoice status is conveyed by colour only
description:
Show a status badge on each invoice row: draft, sent, paid, overdue.

AC:
- Given an invoice, when I view the list, then its row shows a coloured badge for its status.

comments.body: Colour alone will not pass for screen readers or for colour-blind users. The badge needs the status word as visible text, or at minimum an aria-label. Frame 2 in the design file shows the text version.
PR up, four badge colours per AC.
Matches AC. Closing.
Customer using a screen reader reports the status badges read as nothing. Reopening.
Badge conveyed status by colour only; screen readers read nothing. Adding visible text.

title: Invoice draft lost on a flaky connection
description:
Save invoice drafts automatically.

AC:
- Given I am editing an invoice, when I stop typing for 2 seconds, then the draft is saved.
- Given I reload, then the draft is restored.

comments.body: PR up. Autosave on a 2s debounce to the API.
Passes on wifi. On the throttled profile the save request fails silently and the draft is gone after reload.
On a failed or offline save, the draft is lost silently. Adding a local fallback as a follow-up.

title: New accounts see an empty chart instead of a first-invoice prompt
description:
Add a revenue chart to the dashboard.

AC:
- Given I open the dashboard, when invoices exist, then a monthly revenue chart is shown.

comments.body: For brand new accounts with zero invoices, show the Send your first invoice card in place of the chart. An empty chart on day one looks broken.
PR up. Chart renders from the invoices endpoint.
Fresh account shows an empty axis with no bars instead of a first-invoice prompt. Reopening.
Chart rendered empty for brand new accounts. Adding the first-invoice prompt.

title: CSV export returns a file with only a header for filtered views
description:
Add CSV export of the invoice list, respecting the active filters.

AC:
- Given a filtered invoice list, when I click Export, then I receive a CSV of those rows.

comments.body: Flagging that finance runs the filtered export at month end, so this matters more than its size suggests.
PR up. Added a test that the export endpoint returns 200 with the filter params.
Unfiltered export is fine. Any filtered export downloads a header row and nothing else.
Filter params were being dropped by the serializer. Test now asserts row count.

title: Due dates shown as ISO regardless of account locale
description:
Show the due date on each invoice row.

AC:
- Given an invoice with a due date, when I view the list, then the due date is shown on its row.

comments.body: Dates should follow the account locale setting like everywhere else, not ISO. A UK account reading 2026-05-06 as May 6 is the exact complaint we had on the last release.
PR up.
Passes AC.
Two customers report due dates in the wrong format. Reopening.
Rendered ISO regardless of locale. Now follows the account locale setting. Fixed.

title: PDF total differs from on-screen total by one cent
description:
Add tax to the invoice total.

AC:
- Given line items with tax, when I view the invoice, then the total includes tax.

comments.body: PR up, per-line rounding on screen.
Passes.
PDF export shows a total one cent off the screen for some invoices. The PDF path rounds the summed total. Reopening.
PDF path was rounding the summed total instead of each line. Aligned both paths to per-line rounding, and wrote the rule into docs/conventions.md.

title: Viewer role can open the client bank details tab
description:
Add a Viewer role that can see invoices and clients.

AC:
- Given a Viewer, when they open Clients, then they can view client records.
- Given a Viewer, then they cannot create or edit anything.

comments.body: One more thing from the compliance review: Viewers must not see the Bank details tab on a client record at all. Read-only is not enough for that tab.
PR up. Viewer is read-only across clients and invoices.
Viewer can open Bank details and read the account number, which should be hidden for that role. Reopening.
Bank details tab was reachable for Viewer. Hiding the tab for Viewer.

title: Active user count on billing page is wrong
description:
Show the number of active users on the billing page so account owners can see what they are paying for.

AC:
- Given I open Billing, then I see the count of active users.

comments.body: PR up. Active means not deactivated.
Count matches users minus deactivated. Passes.
Owners say the count is too high. Active on the billing page should mean signed in within the last 30 days, which is what we bill on.
Count was based on not-deactivated instead of signed-in within 30 days. Changing the query.

title: Filter bar overflows the screen on phones
description:
Add a filter bar to the invoice list: status, client, date range.

AC:
- Given the invoice list, when I set a filter, then the list updates.

comments.body: Under 600px the bar collapses to a single Filters button that opens a sheet. Frame 4. Otherwise three controls do not fit.
PR up, three filters inline.
On a phone the third filter is off screen and the page scrolls sideways. Reopening.
Filter bar overflowed on narrow screens. Adding the collapsed layout.

title: Send button unreachable by keyboard on the invoice editor
description:
Add a Send button to the invoice editor toolbar.

AC:
- Given a draft invoice, when I click Send, then the invoice is emailed and its status becomes sent.

comments.body: The toolbar in this editor is the one from Frame 6 and has not changed since March, in case that helps while you are in there.
PR up.
Works with a mouse. Tabbing through the toolbar skips Send; it is a div with an onClick instead of a button.
Changed to a button element so it is reachable by keyboard.
